ruleDefinitions.name: Potentially Suspicious Command Targeting Teams Sensitive Files
ruleDefinitions.description:
Detects a commandline containing references to the Microsoft Teams database or cookies files from a process other than Teams.
The database might contain authentication tokens and other sensitive information about the logged in accounts.

sequences.query: (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Microsoft\\\\Teams\\\\Cookies.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Microsoft\\\\Teams\\\\Local\\ Storage\\\\leveldb.*")) AND  NOT (process_path = RGX("\\\\Microsoft\\\\Teams\\\\current\\\\Teams\\\.exe$"))
